scope: Standalone progression visual assets only; no runtime/CSS/state wiring.

designIntent.sharedLanguage: Bright image-led progression art using the established Home blue/purple/gold palette, soft depth, white edge highlights and grounded shadows.
designIntent.sceneConstraint: Keep art self-contained and separable from the W13 environment asset; do not bake these illustrations into the room background or lower-center hero corridor.
designIntent.responsiveConstraint: Illustrations must retain identity at approximately 240x140 card scale. Actual 320/390 Home reachability remains an integration test owned by the screen/mobile finishing lanes.
designIntent.stateConstraint: All counters, owned state, mastery evidence and daily completion remain live runtime data; the art is decorative and neutral.

assets.name: Daily Quests decorative illustration
assets.intent: Exactly three neutral symbolic stations: Quest card, transfer bridge and reward parcel. Neutral bullets avoid implying completion.

assets.name: Today Learning decorative illustration
assets.intent: Open book, pencil, geometry pieces and star path; no mastery percentage, answer, score or subject-progress claim.

assets.name: Mastery decorative illustration
assets.intent: Dimensional star medallion and learning evidence cards; decorative only and does not imply a star count or mastered skill.

assets.name: Rewards and Customization decorative illustration
assets.intent: Dimensional wardrobe, room-style station, swatches and reward parcel without depicting a real catalog item ID, ownership count, price or earned-reward state.

review.note: 15 may assign independent visual review/integration later. Asset presence does not imply Home parity or responsive acceptance.
